newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian Jan-Sept investments 8.1 pct up yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Romanian Jan-Sept investments 8.1 pct up yr/yr.

text.p: Investments in Romania climbed by 8.1 percent in the first nine months of 1996 from a year ago to 13 trillion lei, a National Statistics Board report showed.
It said higher investments in the private sector boosted output in the transport means and equipment sector.
Construction work rose by 7.0 percent over January-September from the same period last year, taking 44.1 percent of nine-month investments.
The private sector's stake in nine-month investments soared to 50.1 percent this year from 37.2 percent in 1995.
Investments in the manufacturing sector took 26.3 percent of total investments over January-September, when retail trade, transport, banking and real estate held about 35.4 percent.
More than 72 percent of the investments were funded from companies' own sources, while 5.3 percent of them have been financed through local credits.

Official forecasts said investments are expected to rise by 8.8 percent in 1996. Last year, investments were up 10.5 percent from 1994 and made up 18 percent of gross domestic product. ($=3,618 lei) -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
